exposure: previous pregnancy/labor-related indication for cesarean section (maternal/fetal)
cohort: The study included 314 pregnant women with previous cesarean sections from public and private health facilities in Dire Dawa.
finding: A significant proportion (a quarter) of pregnant women with previous cesarean sections experienced high fear of childbirth, which was associated with factors such as unemployment, previous and current pregnancy complications, unplanned pregnancy, recurrent cesarean section, and low social support.
mod_finding: Recurrent cesarean section delivery was identified as a factor associated with increased severe fear of childbirth.
